responsibility: Index document for the `dmd/root` portability and utility layer bundled with the D front end. It summarizes the purpose of low-level helper modules such as arrays, files, strings, hashing, memory management, floating-point support, and optional values, helping navigate the support library rather than implementing compilation behavior itself.
same_name_distinction: This README is specific to the `root/` portability layer. Unlike the top-level `gcc/d/dmd/README.md`, it does not describe compiler-stage layout for the whole subtree, and unlike `common/README.md`, it catalogs the broader low-level `root` utility library with containers, memory, hashing, floating-point, Unicode, and path/string support.
